sentences.en: Hi, I'm Lorenzo from Italy and I love Home at Your Mother.

sentences.zh: 我可以连续聊上好几个小时，聊这部剧如何在非常艰难的时期给予我帮助，

sentences.en: but the last time I saw an episode, yesterday of course, I realized that.
sentences.zh: 但昨天我照常看了一集之后，我突然意识到，

sentences.en: It makes me feel good, but not simply good because it's funny or whatever,
sentences.zh: 它让我感觉很好，不只是因为搞笑或者其他原因而觉得好，

sentences.en: I'm talking about really good, such as when you listen to music that makes you feel alive,
sentences.zh: 我说的是那种真正的好，就像听一首让你热血沸腾的音乐，

sentences.en: playing your favorite sport, eating a great pizza, such as when you are with the people you love.
sentences.zh: 打你最喜欢的运动，吃一个美味的披萨，就像和你爱的人在一起那样。

sentences.en: Because when you watch Home at Your Mother it's so powerful that you feel you're part of the gang

sentences.en: and you feel like you are in the 10th season and you don't know what happens then,
sentences.zh: 你会觉得仿佛身处第十季，虽然你还不知道接下来会发生什么，

sentences.en: but it also heals the little cracks in your heart.
sentences.zh: 但它也能抚平你心中的裂痕。

sentences.en: The show is written, directed, and played so splendidly with the plot, any jokes and details,

sentences.en: that at the end you watch any episode and for that 20 minutes you are happy.
sentences.zh: 以至于看完任何一集，在接下来的20分钟里你都是快乐的。

sentences.en: You have that stupid smile or a little tear on your face, but also deep inside.

sentences.en: You can't cling to the past, but the past makes who you are.
